description: This file defines the BuzzFeedPost class within the OrangeHRM system, representing a social media post (including shares and attachments) in the Buzz module. It includes attributes for employee information, post details, owner details, and methods to access post metadata, media, and permissions.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPost
classes.description: Represents a social media post or share within the OrangeHRM Buzz module, encapsulating details about the post content, owner, media, engagement metrics, and permissions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the share.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text/content of the post or share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the post type (video, photo, or text).

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Provides engagement metrics such as likes, comments, and shares.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the post in Y-m-d format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the post in H:i format.

methods.name: getOriginalPost
methods.description: Returns original post details for shared posts.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns employee details associated with the post.

methods.name: isLiked
methods.description: Indicates whether the current user has liked the post.

methods.name: getVideoLink
methods.description: Returns the video link if the post contains a video.

methods.name: getPhotoIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of photos attached to the post.

methods.name: hasPhotos
methods.description: Checks if the post contains photos.

methods.name: hasVideo
methods.description: Checks if the post contains a video.

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description: Returns permissions related to updating or deleting the post.
